name: kamehameha
description: Dragon Ball Z band above the prompt: every turn charges a Kamehameha, fires a beam when it ends, and shows your Ki (context) gauge.

animate.title: Animate
animate.description: Shimmer on the charging bar and the beam shooting out (off: static bars).

showKiGauge.title: Ki gauge
showKiGauge.description: Second line: the context window as a Ki gauge.

showSummary.title: Last-attack summary
showSummary.description: When idle, a line summing up the last turn (time, techniques, tokens, Ki).

fireBeam.title: Fire the beam
fireBeam.description: When a turn ends, fire the beam across the band for 4 seconds.

showUsageGauges.title: Usage gauges
showUsageGauges.description: Stamina (5h) and Training (7d) usage-limit gauges with reset countdown and a runs-out-at-this-pace warning.

showCacheGauge.title: Cache gauge
showCacheGauge.description: How much of the input tokens came from the prompt cache this session.

showZeni.title: Zeni (cost)
showZeni.description: Session cost and cost per turn; a gauge when a budget is set.

zeniBudget.title: Zeni budget (USD)
zeniBudget.description: Session budget in US dollars for the Zeni gauge; 0 shows the cost without a gauge.

hintBars.title: Bars under the prompt
hintBars.description: Mini Ki and usage bars at the end of the hint line under the prompt.
